# What does this PR do?

Converges the layer-wise distributed optimizer (Muon), its sibling `DistributedOptimizer` and Muon's QKV handling with the dev branch, so that main and dev carry one implementation of this area. The companion PR against dev applies the same code there: https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/pull/8920.

Production code: +1386 / −603 across 24 files (tests: +1531 / −234).

## Changes

| Commit | Change |
| --- | --- |
| LayerWise: explicit param layout strategy with a compact layout | `DistributedDataParallelConfig.layer_wise_param_layout` / `--layer-wise-param-layout {padded,compact}`. `padded` stays the default with unchanged numerics. `compact` (from dev) keeps the Muon matrices in unpadded, unsharded buffers, all-reduces their gradients and has one owner per matrix gather it whole, which avoids the `dp_size × max(shard)` padding. Expert non-Muon params get an expert-DP sibling `DistributedOptimizer`. Also fixes experts without an owner when dp_cp = 1 and expt_dp > 1, and a crash when rank 0 owns no parameter. |
| LayerWise: whole-param FP8 gathers and gather publication | Compact layout: MXFP8 and blockwise FP8 params are gathered as BF16 staged from the owners' FP32 masters and requantized on every rank. `force_sync` and `free_overlap_buffers` publish in-flight uneven gathers. |
| Muon: QKV layout metadata with opt-in per-head and MLA splits | `QKVLayout` metadata on the fused projections; `--muon-split-qkv-per-head` and `--muon-split-mla-qkv`, both off by default. |
| Optimizer checkpoint fixes for the layer-wise chain | Reject `--ckpt-format torch` for the layer-wise optimizer: the torch format does not save the sibling `DistributedOptimizer` (main raised at the first save). Keep the `HybridDeviceOptimizer` step across a DP-reshardable resume. Fix an undefined name in `split_state_dict_if_needed` and a call to a missing `parallel_state` helper. |
| ChainedOptimizer: combine grad norms on the device | float64 on the device; bitwise identical to the previous host-side combination. |
| LayerWise: write whole-param FP8 params as Q(bf16(master)) once | Owners no longer quantize params that the gather requantizes; params outside any gather take the same Q(bf16(master)). |
| QK-clip: find attention modules of HybridModel and MTP stacks | Main raised `AttributeError: 'MambaLayer' object has no attribute 'self_attention'`. |
| DDP: optional torch_memory_saver buffers without CPU backup | `--disable-grad-buffers-cpu-backup` / `--disable-param-buffers-cpu-backup` (from dev). |
| LayerWise: drop the legacy layout and the boolean layout flags | Removes the legacy layout (`--no-use-layer-wise-param-layout`) and the boolean `use_layer_wise_param_layout` spelling. The layer-wise optimizer always chains a sibling `DistributedOptimizer` and rejects chunks wrapped without a LayerWise layout. Docs in `docs/user-guide/features/dist_optimizer.md`. |
| DDP: partition bucket groups by owner and DDP config | `partition_buckets()` built every fp8 bucket group with the config of the last buffer it had looped over, so with the compact layout and `reduce_scatter_with_fp32_accumulation` LayerWise and DistOpt buckets could get each other's collectives. Buffers are now partitioned by optimizer ownership and DDP config first. Models without the layer-wise optimizer keep the same bucket groups. |
| Optimizer: build the layer-wise optimizer for fully frozen stages | A pipeline stage whose params are all frozen was rejected while the other stages continued into a collective. |
| LayerWise: reject FP8 params the padded layout cannot publish | The padded gather moves raw FP8 bytes but not their scales; only MXFP8 staged through `--reuse-grad-buf-for-mxfp8-param-ag` is requantized on every rank. Blockwise FP8 (and MXFP8 without the reused grad buffer) now raises and points to the compact layout. |

## Behavior changes for main users

- The legacy layout (`--no-use-layer-wise-param-layout`) is removed. On H100 it was neither faster nor smaller than padded/compact; its largest rank holds the whole embedding and output-layer Adam state. Optimizer state saved with it, and LayerWise checkpoints written before the sibling `DistributedOptimizer` was added (May 2026), cannot be loaded: start from such checkpoints with `--no-load-optim`.
- `--ckpt-format torch` is rejected for the layer-wise optimizer; use `torch_dist`.
- With `--fp8-param-gather`, the padded layout accepts only MXFP8 with `--reuse-grad-buf-for-mxfp8-param-ag`. Use `--layer-wise-param-layout compact` for blockwise FP8 params.
- Default (padded) training is numerically unchanged.

## Testing

- 8×H100 and 8×B300 under `--deterministic-mode`, comparing loss and grad norm at every step:
  - padded, padded with overlap, MoE, MoE with bias, Lion and PP2 with tied embeddings are bitwise identical to the main baseline;
  - the legacy removal, bucket-group partition and frozen-stage commits are bitwise neutral on padded and compact (dense, overlap, MoE, MoE with bias, B300 MXFP8 with and without overlap); the last commit only adds a check when the optimizer is built;
  - `torch_dist` checkpoints written by the main baseline resume bitwise, and padded and compact checkpoints load across layouts.
- Unit tests: layout resolution and compact ownership (CPU), compact layout end to end with a bit-exact replay registered in the determinism manifest, whole-param FP8 requantize replay, QKV / MLA splits, bucket-group partition regression, fully frozen stage, padded FP8 check; existing LayerWise, distributed checkpointing, DDP, emerging-optimizer and FP8 suites updated for the removed layout.
- Functional tests: `gpt3_moe_mcore_te_ep8_resume_torch_dist_dist_muon` and its `_1node` variant ran the removed legacy layout and now pin `--layer-wise-param-layout compact`. Their golden values were recorded with the legacy layout and need a refresh. GitHub CI does not run these cases: the H100 recipe is marked broken, the GB200 and GB300 cases run in the internal `mr` scope and the `_1node` case is temporarily disabled.

No code was copied from other repositories. Parts are adapted from this repository's dev branch.

 - Call all-gather on each DP rank.
 - The parameter buffer now contains all 16 updated `bf16` model parameter elements. Parameters in PyTorch modules already point to the correct views in this buffer, so forward passes can start after the all-gather completes.
 - At this point, you can zero the gradient buffer for the next iteration.
+
+## Layer-Wise Distributed Optimizer
+
+Matrix optimizers such as Muon need each weight matrix whole. With `--optimizer muon --use-distributed-optimizer`, Megatron uses the layer-wise distributed optimizer: one data-parallel rank updates each Muon-managed matrix and then all-gathers it to the other ranks. A regular distributed optimizer next to it shards the remaining parameters (embeddings, output layer, biases, norms) as described above.
+
+`--layer-wise-param-layout` selects how the Muon-managed matrices are laid out across data-parallel ranks:
+
+| Layout | Gradient reduction | Parameter gather | Buffers |
+| ------ | ------ | ------ | ------ |
+| `padded` (default) | reduce-scatter | fixed-size all-gather from the parameter buffer | Each matrix lies whole inside one rank's shard; shards are padded to equal size. |
+| `compact` | all-reduce | all-gather of whole matrices with uneven sizes | No padding; every rank chooses the same owner rank for each matrix. |
+
+Both layouts store the same optimizer state, so a `torch_dist` checkpoint saved with one layout loads with the other. The layer-wise optimizer supports `--ckpt-format torch_dist` only.
+
+With `--fp8-param-gather`, the padded layout gathers the FP8 bytes of each shard and supports MXFP8 only together with `--reuse-grad-buf-for-mxfp8-param-ag`, which stages BF16 values and requantizes them on every rank. Use the compact layout for blockwise FP8 parameters; it gathers BF16 values and requantizes them on every rank.
+
+### Checkpoints of the removed legacy layout
+
+The legacy layout, selected with `--no-use-layer-wise-param-layout`, was removed together with the boolean `--use-layer-wise-param-layout` / `--no-use-layer-wise-param-layout` flags. It was also the only layout before the layer-wise optimizer gained its sibling distributed optimizer in May 2026. It kept the Adam-managed parameters inside the layer-wise optimizer, so its checkpoints store their optimizer state in a format that the current layouts do not read. Loading the optimizer state of such a checkpoint fails with a `KeyError` naming a `chained_*.optimizer.distributed.*` key.
+
+- To start a new run from such a checkpoint, such as fine-tuning, load only the model weights with `--no-load-optim`. The optimizer state starts fresh.
+- To resume an interrupted run, keep using the Megatron-LM version that wrote the checkpoint.
+- To carry the optimizer state over, convert the checkpoint yourself: the Muon state uses the same keys in every layout, and only the state of the Adam-managed parameters differs. Otherwise, open an issue describing the use case.

+def _ddp_chunk(params):
+    """Exposes the DDP buffer metadata ``_build_param_sort_keys`` reads."""
+    index_map, start = {}, 0
+    for param in reversed(params):
+        index_map[param] = (start, start + param.numel(), 0)
+        start += param.numel()
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        buffers=[SimpleNamespace(param_index_map=index_map)], expert_parallel_buffers=[]
+    )
+
+
+def _owners(params_in_group_order, sort_keys, dp_size, rank):
+    """Run the ping-pong assignment for ``rank`` with mocked process groups."""

+    lwo = LayerWiseDistributedOptimizer.__new__(LayerWiseDistributedOptimizer)

+    with (

+        mock.patch(

+        ),
+    ):
+        lwo.shard_params([optimizer], param_sort_keys=sort_keys)
+    local = [p for group in groups for p in group["params"]]
+    return lwo.dp_cp_params_list, local

+def test_compact_owners_do_not_depend_on_param_group_order():
+    # Equal-numel params are where a numel-only stable sort could disagree across ranks.
+    params = [_param((8, 8)) for _ in range(6)] + [_param((4, 8)) for _ in range(3)]
+    sort_keys = LayerWiseDistributedOptimizer._build_param_sort_keys([_ddp_chunk(params)])

+        assert set(local) == set(reference[rank])
+    # Every param has exactly one owner.
+    assert sorted(id(p) for owned in reference for p in owned) == sorted(id(p) for p in params)

+
+The compact layout keeps Muon-managed matrices in unpadded, replicated DDP buffers (gradient
+all-reduce, one owner rank per matrix, uneven parameter all-gather) while a sibling
+DistributedOptimizer shards the remaining parameters. Each test trains a small model for a few
+steps with real NCCL collectives and checks the DDP structure, rank-consistent ownership and the

+"""

+class _DenseAndExpertModel(nn.Module):
+    """Dense and expert matrices (Muon) with biases (Adam) and an excluded matrix (Adam)."""
+
+    def __init__(self, with_experts=False, hidden=64):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.fc1 = nn.Linear(32, hidden)
+        self.fc2 = nn.Linear(hidden, hidden)
+        self.fc3 = nn.Linear(hidden, 48)
+        self.gate = nn.Linear(48, 48, bias=False)
+        self.gate.weight.use_muon = False
+        self.out = nn.Linear(48, 16)
+        self.with_experts = with_experts
+        if with_experts:
+            # Named "experts" so the Muon factory tags them for the expert TP group.
+            self.experts = nn.ModuleList([nn.Linear(48, 48) for _ in range(3)])
+            for param in self.experts.parameters():
+                param.allreduce = False
+
+    def forward(self, x):
+        x = F.relu(self.fc1(x))
+        x = F.relu(self.fc2(x))
+        x = F.relu(self.fc3(x))
+        x = x + torch.tanh(self.gate(x))
+        if self.with_experts:
+            for expert in self.experts:
+                x = x + 0.5 * torch.tanh(expert(x))
+        return self.out(x)

+    if isinstance(optimizer, LayerWiseDistributedOptimizer):
+        return optimizer
+    for sub_optimizer in getattr(optimizer, 'chained_optimizers', [optimizer]):
+        if isinstance(sub_optimizer, LayerWiseDistributedOptimizer):
+            return sub_optimizer
+    raise AssertionError("No LayerWiseDistributedOptimizer in the optimizer chain")
+

+def _distopts(optimizer):
+    return [
+        sub_optimizer
+        for sub_optimizer in getattr(optimizer, 'chained_optimizers', [optimizer])
+        if isinstance(sub_optimizer, DistributedOptimizer)
+    ]
